terms.definitionEn: A pattern that matches elements by their tag name.
terms.definitionAr: نمط بيختار العناصر حسب اسم الوسم بتاعها.

terms.definitionEn: A pattern that matches elements carrying a named class.
terms.definitionAr: نمط بيختار العناصر اللي عليها class باسم معين.

terms.definitionEn: A pattern that matches an element carrying a particular identifier.
terms.definitionAr: نمط بيختار العنصر اللي عليه معرّف محدد.

terms.definitionEn: A pattern that matches elements according to an HTML attribute and optionally its value.
terms.definitionAr: نمط بيختار العناصر حسب خاصية HTML وممكن كمان حسب قيمتها.

terms.definitionEn: Whitespace between patterns matches a nested element at any depth inside another match.
terms.definitionAr: مسافة بين نمطين بتختار عنصر متداخل بأي عمق جوه العنصر الأول.

terms.definitionEn: A greater-than sign matches elements that are immediate children of the preceding match.
terms.definitionAr: علامة أكبر من بتختار العناصر الأبناء المباشرين للعنصر السابق.

terms.definitionEn: A selector weight used to compare competing declarations when origin and importance are equal.
terms.definitionAr: وزن للـ selector بيتقارن لما القواعد المتنافسة تكون من نفس الأصل والأهمية.

terms.definitionEn: The process that resolves competing style declarations according to origin, importance, layers, and selector weight.
terms.definitionAr: طريقة حسم قواعد التنسيق المتعارضة حسب الأصل والأهمية والطبقات ووزن الـ selector.

terms.definitionEn: The behavior by which some computed values pass from a parent element to its descendants.
terms.definitionAr: سلوك بتنتقل فيه قيم محسوبة معينة من العنصر الأب للعناصر اللي جواه.

terms.definitionEn: Comma-separated patterns that apply the same rule block to each listed match.
terms.definitionAr: أنماط مفصولة بفواصل بتطبق نفس مجموعة القواعد على كل عنصر مطابق.

terms.definitionEn: A declaration marker that raises priority within the cascade's importance ordering.
terms.definitionAr: علامة على القاعدة بترفع أولويتها في ترتيب الأهمية داخل الـ cascade.

terms.definitionEn: The later position of otherwise tied declarations in the stylesheet processing order.
terms.definitionAr: الموضع المتأخر للقواعد المتعادلة في ترتيب قراءة ملفات التنسيق.
terms.example:
p { color: teal; }
p { color: olive; }

questions.question: Which elements match this rule?
options: Only the element whose id is p
Every p nested inside another p
questions.explanation: A type pattern matches elements with that tag name regardless of their classes.
questions.explanationAr: الـ type selector بيختار كل عنصر اسمه p بغض النظر عن الـ class.

questions.question: Which elements match the selector?
options: The element whose id is notice
Elements with a notice attribute, whatever its value
questions.explanation: A leading period introduces a class pattern in a selector.
questions.explanationAr: النقطة في بداية الـ selector معناها اختيار class اسمها notice.

questions.question: Which target does this pattern select?
questions.explanation: The hash sign introduces an ID selector.
questions.explanationAr: علامة # بتبدأ selector بيختار العنصر اللي له id اسمه sidebar.

questions.question: Which controls match this selector?
options: Inputs whose value is required text
Inputs that have the required attribute
questions.explanation: An attribute selector without a value test matches elements where that attribute is present.
questions.explanationAr: الـ attribute selector من غير قيمة بيختار العنصر لو الخاصية موجودة.

questions.code:
p { color: teal; }
p { color: olive; }
questions.explanation: With equal origin, importance, layer, and specificity, the later declaration wins.
questions.explanationAr: لما الأصل والأهمية والطبقة والـ specificity يتساووا، القاعدة الأخيرة هي اللي بتكسب.

questions.prompt: Select elements carrying the class named card.
questions.explanation: A period before a name selects elements by class.
questions.explanationAr: النقطة قبل الاسم بتختار العناصر حسب الـ class.

questions.prompt: Select the unique element whose id is header.
questions.explanation: The hash sign introduces an ID selector.
questions.explanationAr: علامة # بتستخدم لاختيار عنصر حسب الـ id.

questions.question: Does this pattern match a p nested several levels inside article?
options: No, only an immediate child p matches
Only a p with class article matches
Only the first p in the document matches
questions.explanation: Whitespace is the descendant combinator and allows any nesting depth.
questions.explanationAr: المسافة معناها descendant، فبتسمح بأي عمق من التداخل.

questions.question: Where can the inherited text color come from?
options: A matching color on an ancestor
The first child element in the document
questions.explanation: The color property is inherited, so descendants can receive a value from an ancestor unless overridden.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية color بتتورث، فالعنصر ممكن ياخد قيمتها من أبوه لو مفيش override.

questions.explanation: The ID selector has greater specificity than the class selector, so its declaration wins here.
questions.explanationAr: الـ ID selector أعلى specificity من الـ class selector، فقاعدته هي اللي بتكسب.

questions.prompt: Select only links that are direct children of .menu.
questions.explanation: The child combinator matches only immediate children.
questions.explanationAr: علامة > بتختار الأبناء المباشرين بس.

questions.prompt: Match inputs whose type attribute is exactly email.
questions.explanation: The attribute name and value together restrict the match to email inputs.
questions.explanationAr: اسم الخاصية وقيمتها مع بعض بيحددوا input من نوع email.

questions.question: Which declaration wins for an element matching both patterns?
options: The class-only rule because it appears later
The ID selector has greater specificity
Neither rule because the selectors conflict
questions.explanation: The selector containing an ID has greater specificity than the class-only selector.
questions.explanationAr: الـ selector اللي فيه ID أعلى specificity من selector فيه class بس.

questions.prompt: Mark this declaration as important in the cascade.
questions.explanation: The marker changes the declaration's importance priority; it should be used sparingly.
questions.explanationAr: العلامة دي بترفع أولوية القاعدة، والأفضل استخدامها بحذر.

questions.question: What does the comma do in this rule?
options: It requires an h2 to contain an h3
It lowers the weight of the h3 pattern
It makes h3 inherit only from h2
questions.explanation: A comma-separated selector list applies one rule block to every listed selector.
questions.explanationAr: قائمة الـ selectors المفصولة بفاصلة بتطبق نفس القواعد على كل واحد.

questions.prompt: Group h1 and h2 so both receive the same line height.
questions.explanation: A comma separates independent selectors in a selector list.
questions.explanationAr: الفاصلة بتفصل selectors مستقلة جوه قائمة واحدة.

questions.explanation: An important author declaration outranks a normal author declaration, even when the latter has an ID selector.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة author عليها important بتسبق قاعدة author عادية حتى لو العادية فيها ID.

questions.question: Why can the later .item rule override the first rule here?
options: The ID makes the first pattern stronger
The ID inside :where() still adds selector weight
Both weigh one class; later source order wins
questions.explanation: :where() and its argument contribute zero specificity, leaving the first selector with only the class weight.
questions.explanationAr: ‎:where() واللي جواها specificity بتاعتهم صفر، فوزن القاعدة الأولى يفضل class واحد.

questions.prompt: Give this notice rule an ID selector for the element named summary.
questions.explanation: An ID selector contributes more specificity than a class or type selector.
questions.explanationAr: الـ ID selector بيدي specificity أعلى من class أو type selector.

questions.prompt: Override inherited text color for one matching paragraph with a deliberate important declaration.
questions.explanation: An explicit declaration on the paragraph replaces inherited color; the importance marker elevates its cascade priority.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة صريحة على الفقرة بتستبدل اللون الموروث، وimportant بيرفع أولويتها.

questions.question: How is selector specificity compared, and when does it matter?
keyPoints: Compare ID, class/attribute/pseudo-class, then type counts
Compare the columns as a tuple rather than summing digits
Only compare after earlier cascade precedence stages
Pseudo-classes such as :where() have defined exceptions
questions.modelAnswer: Specificity is compared by its ID, class-like, and type-selector components as a tuple, not as one summed score. It matters after earlier cascade precedence such as origin, importance, and layer has been resolved.
questions.explanation: Specificity is one stage of the cascade and is compared in ordered components.
questions.explanationAr: الـ specificity مرحلة من الـ cascade وبتتقارن بمكونات مرتبة.

questions.question: What determines which declaration wins when several rules match one property?
keyPoints: Source order as a later tie-breaker
questions.modelAnswer: The cascade first considers origin and importance, then layer precedence, specificity, and later tie-breakers such as source order. The last rule wins only when the earlier stages leave the declarations tied.
questions.explanation: Source order is not the only cascade criterion; it resolves ties after higher-priority stages.
questions.explanationAr: ترتيب المصدر مش العامل الوحيد؛ بيحسم التعادل بعد مراحل أعلى أولوية.

questions.question: Which CSS values typically inherit, and how should inherited styling be used?
keyPoints: Box-model properties generally do not inherit by default
A child can override an inherited value
Use inheritance to share appropriate defaults
questions.modelAnswer: Text-related values such as color and font properties commonly inherit, while many box-model properties do not. A child can set its own declaration, so inheritance is useful for shared defaults rather than a guarantee that every property passes down.
questions.explanation: Inheritance applies only to properties defined to inherit or explicitly configured to do so.
questions.explanationAr: التوريث بيحصل لخصائص محددة أو لما يتطلب صراحة، مش لكل الخصائص.

questions.question: Why should !important usually be a last resort?
keyPoints: It makes later overrides less straightforward
Repeated use can create fragile rule conflicts
Prefer clearer selectors and component-level design
questions.modelAnswer: The marker changes cascade priority, which can make later overrides and component styling harder to reason about. Prefer clear rule organization and appropriate selectors, reserving it for cases where the priority change is intentional.
questions.explanation: Unnecessary importance markers make cascade behavior harder to maintain.
questions.explanationAr: استخدام العلامة من غير ضرورة بيصعّب فهم تعارض القواعد وصيانتها.
